title: Quiggly's Lasagna
ingredients: 1 large can San Marzano tomatoes (blue can)
Ricotta cheese mix: ricotta cheese 16 oz
instructions: Brown meat / onions / garlic / basil / Calabrian chili
Add tomato sauce / etc. and sugar & seasonings / wine. Simmer 1 hr.
Combine ricotta / parsley / basil / Boursin / egg and mix
Preheat oven 375°
Assemble in 9x13
Bake 25 min covered w/ foil, and 25 min uncovered (top w/ more spaghetti sauce)

title: No Boil Baked Ziti
instructions: Preheat oven 400°
Cook garlic in butter on cast iron 1 min
Add sausage, cook / break up ~6 min, add S&P (and broccoli)
Add marinara, water, basil, 1/2 cup ricotta, stir
Add pasta. Cover w/ foil, bake 30 min
Remove, mix, add mozzarella and dollops of ricotta
Broil for 5-7 min
Add fresh basil & serve

title: Alexa's Tuscan Chicken Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta, reserve 1 cup pasta water
Cook chicken
Cook bacon and reserve 1/2 fat in pan
To bacon skillet add garlic, tomatoes, spinach and cook, then add S&P, coconut cream, parm and pasta water
Add pasta, bacon + chicken
Garnish w/ additional parm and basil

title: Bolognese a la Quiggly (Patsy Spaghetti)
ingredients: 2 cans diced tomatoes, not stewed (16 oz)
instructions: Combine all ingredients.

title: Cassidy's Pasta Water Pasta
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet, add sausage. Cook, turning, until browned (10 min). Remove to a plate, reserve pan and drippings
Bring large pot water to a boil, add rabe and cook for ~5 minutes. Rinse under cold water, keep boiling water
Add pasta to reserved boiling water until al dente
Meanwhile heat drippings over medium heat and add garlic, cook until browned
Add broccoli, red pepper flakes, cook 5 minutes
Add mixture + sausage to pasta and serve with 1/4 cup pasta water

title: Creamy Sun Dried Tomato Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb cubed chicken (seasoned w/ Italian / S&P / Dan-O's / etc.)
1 can chopped sun dried tomatoes in oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients.

title: Zuppa Toscana
ingredients: Red chili flakes, S&P to taste
instructions: Add EVOO, onion + garlic to medium heat and season
Add in ground sausage, cook until brown
Sprinkle in flour
Add potatoes & kale
Pour in chicken broth and milk and bring to a boil. Cover and cook on low for 15 mins
Add lemon juice and season to taste

title: Agi's Grilled Corn Salad
instructions: Grill corn, onion & jalapeno
Combine with all other ingredients in a bowl and mix
Chill & serve

title: Roto Chick Noodle Soup
instructions: Heat onion / oil in pot for 6-8 min
Add carrot / celery / garlic / herbs / seasonings, cook 5 min
Add bay leaf & chicken broth. Bring to boil. Reduce to simmer for 45 min
Add noodles / chicken & combine & serve

title: Chicken Tortilla Soup
ingredients: 1 can seasoned black beans, drained / rinsed
32 oz Swanson crafted roasted chicken broth
Tortilla chips, avocado & cheese for serving
Seasoning: a lot of spicy Dan-O's chicken seasoning
instructions: Heat oil in Dutch oven / large pot. Add garlic, jalapeno, onion and cook for 5-6 min
Add all other ingredients, combine, and bring to boil. Cook for 5 min & simmer for 5 min
Add shredded chicken, combine, 2 min
Add cilantro, remove from heat, serve w/ cheese & avocado

title: Big Bottoms Taco Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup salsa (buy or see earlier recipe)
instructions: Add onions w/ oil & cook for 4 min, add garlic, bell pepper, jalapeno, little seasoning, cook 2 more min
Add turkey and seasoning, cook
Add salsa, corn, black beans, chipotle
Simmer for a while (45 min+)
Make salad, serve

title: Quiggly's Tomato Basil Soup
ingredients: 1 large can San Marzano tomatoes (blue one)
instructions: Cut tomatoes / onion in half, place on baking sheet & cook on 420° for 35 min (flip halfway)
Put garlic head w/ cut top on foil w/ oil / salt / pepper in oven too
In large pot, add EVOO and diced onion for 5 min w/ Calabrian chilis & garlic
Add tomatoes / canned tomatoes / onion / basil / S&P
Simmer 30 min. Add milk / cream
Blend / taste / season / serve

title: Agi's Chipotle Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine ingredients & enjoy

title: Buffalo White Bean Chicken Chili Soup
instructions: Heat Dutch oven on high w/ oil & sear seasoned chicken on both sides. Remove, set aside
Add 2 tbs oil to same pot on medium & add onion / pepper / jalapeno, saute 5 min
Add garlic, seasonings, beans & cook 1 min more
Add the chicken back on top, add 2 cup broth & bring to a boil, reduce heat, simmer w/ lid closed 12-15 min. When done, shred chicken & add back to pot
Add remaining broth, coconut milk and simmer & cover for 10 min
Remove from heat, add cilantro & lime
Serve w/ cilantro / chips / guac / cheese

title: Ranch Dressing

instructions: Combine, mix, serve

title: Quiggly's Chipotle Honey Vinaigrette Dressing

Alt version: 3 tbs chipotle in adobo
Alt version: 1/2 cup oil as blended
instructions: Add all ingredients to food processor & blend
Bottle & serve

title: Chipotle Crema
instructions: Combine all ingredients in food processor

title: Jalapeno Cilantro Lime Crema
instructions: Combine all ingredients in food processor

title: Guacamole
instructions: Add all ingredients to a bowl & mash / combine

title: Caesar Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients.

title: Agi's Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients.

title: Pickled Onions / Peppers
instructions: Slice pepper & onion. Put in mason jar
Add seasoning to jar
Pour over boiling vinegar / water

title: Calabrian Chili Basil Pesto
instructions: Combine salt, pepper, pine nuts, garlic in processor and blend lightly
Add basil and blend lightly
Add cheese and EVOO and peppers & blend
Add lemon & EVOO if needed

title: Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 28 oz can San Marzano or Bianco DiNapoli whole peeled tomatoes
Dash of red pepper chili flake
instructions: Sautee onions / garlic / herbs together 3-5 min
Squeeze tomatoes into bowl & add sautee mix, EVOO, salt, pepper, sugar
Blend w/ stick blender

title: Chipotle Tomatillo Green-Chili Salsa
ingredients: 3 tsp: 2 salt, 1 pepper, 2 cumin, 1 oregano, 2 Dan-O's
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°
Cook tomatillo / tomato / jalapeno / ghost / onion on foil baking sheet until blistering (about 25 min)
Add all ingredients into blender w/ open vent and pulse for 10-15 seconds
Cool & serve

title: Chipotle Chicken Marinade
instructions: Blend in food processor

title: Agi's Steak Sauce
ingredients: 2x NY strip steak, seared in butter
instructions: In steak pan, reduce heat to med / low & add shallot, garlic, & butter, as well as salt / pepper to taste
After fragrant, add heavy cream, Worcestershire sauce, fresh thyme, & cheese and cook until thickened a bit (1-2 min)
Serve on steak & dip

title: Chimichurri Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients.

title: Chili Garlic Crunch Oil
instructions: Add oil to pot w/ garlic / shallot / chili. Cook low / medium 20 min till brown
Strain out crunch
Dump oil into container w/ other ingredients
Once cooled, add back crunch bits

title: Yogurt Sauce
instructions: Combine ingredients, add to bottle, and serve on anything (Mediterranean / chicken / gyro)
Blend in blender

title: Spicy Vodka Sauce
ingredients: 1 large can San Marzano tomatoes (diced / cut / smashed)
Eyeball-pour cream / coconut milk (enough to make sauce light orange color)
instructions: Fill bottom of pot w/ oil, add onion / garlic / chili's / chili pepper flakes / shallot / basil, cook for 5 min
Add vodka, continue cooking 5 more min
Add tomatoes, simmer for 20-30 min
Add cream, simmer / combine 2 min
Season
Add to blender and blend
Make chicken parm sandwich or pasta

title: Quiggly's Lentil Bowls
ingredients: Protein of your choice (we like chicken sausage)
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°
Meanwhile coat brussels in EVOO, salt, pepper and red chili flakes. Bake for ~15 minutes
Meanwhile brown protein and warm lentils
Combine lentils, brussels, protein, beets, avo, arugula and drizzle with balsamic glaze

title: Zuchinni Boats
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Cut zuc longways and use spoon to scoop out the middle. Drizzle w/ EVOO and bake 12 mins
Brown turkey meat, season, add sauce
Add meat / sauce to boats, sprinkle w/ cheese and bake additional 5 minutes

title: Quiggly's Favorite Roasted Carrots
ingredients: Set 1: 1 tsp cumin / 1 tsp paprika / salt / pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°
Combine set 1 ingredients and rub over carrots. Roast in oven till bottoms black (~25 min)
While roasting, combine set 2 ingredients in food processor. Mix, add chicken broth as needed to loosen
Serve carrots on bed of lemon tahini

title: Quiggly's Pot Roast
ingredients: 4 cup beef broth & lil red wine
instructions: Sear meat
Add to crock pot w/ all other ingredients
Cook on low for 8 hours

title: Crispy Garlic Rosemary Potatoes
ingredients: Sack of small Yukon gold potatoes
instructions: Sauce: mince garlic, add in bowl w/ oil & seasoning
Boil potato chunks 10 min
Bake on 2 in thick pan 2 min after coating in sauce
Flip every 20 min till desired done

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Prepare pie crust
Over medium heat w/ butter / EVOO add chicken, carrots, celery. Cook 10 min & set aside
Large skillet over medium, add butter, onions, garlic. Cook 5 min
Whisk in flour, seasonings, broth & cream. Cook until no chunks & simmer until thick (10 min)
Oven bake @ 425°
Place dough in pie tin, cut extra. Add chicken & veggies. Add frozen peas, pour gravy on top
Cover pie w/ 2nd crust. Crimp, & cut slits in top
Baste w/ egg wash & bake 32-38 min

title: Spud's Scallop Potatos
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°
Butter pan and add one layer potatoes, one layer of onion, and 1 more layer potatos (& season)
Melt butter, whisk in flour / salt. Gradually add in milk (1/4 cup at a time), 3-5 min
Stir in all cheese & mix
Pour over potatos & bake ~1.5 hours covered
Broil to finish

title: Smash Burgers
instructions: Combine mayo, ketchup, mustard, pickles & stir. Set in fridge
Mandoline onions super thin
Grate butter into ground beef & form into balls
Smash balls onto hot griddle (w/ onion on top 1st). Season beef & add a bit of mustard. Flip after cooking 70%. Add cheese & cover. Remove w/ bacon
Assemble & enjoy

title: Agi's Ground Chicken Burgers
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl, form into patties and refrigerate
Pan fry patties till done, add cheese, sear bun, assemble sandwich, enjoy

title: Steak Sando
ingredients: 1 or 2 handfuls red / yellow / orange cherry tomatoes, cut in half
2 red chilis or jalapeno or serrano
instructions: Add diced chilis / onion to cast iron & cook on medium high w/ oil for 3 min (add salt / pepper)
Add cut tomatoes & red wine vinegar and basil, cook for another 3 min. Blister / smash tomatoes, set aside
Season steak generously with oil / salt / pepper and cook in cast iron for 3 min a side
Add garlic / butter / rosemary / thyme and baste 2 min. Pull
Add bread to pan / butter
Assemble

title: The Best Grilled Cheese in the World
ingredients: Full loaf sourdough bread, sliced thick
Mayo w/ cheese & herbs (basil / thyme / rosemary)
instructions: Shred cheese
Cut bread
Spread mayo mixture
Spread basil pesto
Heat pan on medium low w/ EVOO & butter
Add bread, stack on cheese
Cook each side till golden brown & cheese melted
Add cheese to pan, put sliced jalapeno down 1st
Add sandwich on top till crispy
Serve

title: Agi's Spicy Philly Cheesesteak
ingredients: Thin sliced ribeye steak (1 package at Ralphs or deli)
Fresh garlic to taste (for bread & steak)
Provolone or queso quesadilla or white American / cheese alternative
instructions: Worcestershire / salt / pepper / steak seasoning / etc. Season steak generously. Cook on cast iron w/ oil & chopped onion / jalapeno / bell pepper / garlic. Remove when medium rare
Cut / pull some bread "meat" out for more steak room
Make garlic / rosemary / butter and add to roll. Sear roll in same cast iron pan, remove
Add steak back to pan and top w/ cheese to melt
Add chipotle mayo to bread and place on top of steak mixture back on cast iron
Pull off and wrap and let soak in for 3 min
Feast

title: Cubano Sandwich
ingredients: Thyme, salt, pepper, cumin, oregano, cilantro
instructions: Trim pork of fat & score. Place in tupperware
Mix all other ingredients on left in blender, blend & pour over pork. Marinate, covered in fridge overnight
Add to pot, pour over sauce & some chicken broth, cover & bake at 335° for 3 hours (cook to 160° internal & shredable)
Toast bread, ham, pork on flattop
Assemble sandwich w/ pickles, cheese, mustard
Sear / press sandwich on both sides w/ butter

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
ingredients: Marinade: 1 tsp salt, cumin, coriander, paprika
Marinade: cayenne, pepper, lemon to taste
Curry sauce: 1 2/3 cup hot tomato sauce & water
Curry sauce: 1 tsp sugar & 3 tbsp butter
Cilantro & naan bread to serve w/ basmati
instructions: Combine ingredients in bowl, mix, store in fridge for 24 hrs
Heat oil in non stick, cook chicken 3 min a side & set aside
Add oil & butter on medium, once melted, add onions, ginger, salt
Cook 5-7 min, reduce heat to medium, add garlic, cook 2 min more
Add curry spices & paprika, cook 2 min more
Add tomato sauce, water, & mix. Bring to simmer, cover, reduce heat & cook on low 15 min stirring occasionally
Blend curry
Return to pot, add cream & sugar & butter, stir / melt / mix
Add chicken back, cook through, pull, cut, return
Serve over basmati rice w/ cilantro & naan

title: Chicken Fried Rice
instructions: Cook rice night before
Make sauce
Add some sauce to diced chicken to marinade
Add oil / butter, cook chicken & season w/ salt / pepper
Add onions & garlic & cook 3-4 min
Add peas / carrots to onion mix. Cook 2 min more
Add chilled rice & remaining sauce on top veggies
Scramble eggs over butter & combine all ingredients
Add diced green onions

title: Shakshuka
ingredients: 1 tsp paprika / caraway seed / cumin seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°
Heat EVOO in cast iron & add beef. Cook & crumble till pink is gone
Add diced onion, bell pep, jalapeno, cook 3-5 min
Add seasoning, garlic and chipotle, cook 2 min
Add tomatoes, tomato sauce, feta, honey & stir / combine
Make 4 nests w/ wooden spoons & drop eggs
Transfer pan to oven, cook 10 min till eggs set
Melt butter w/ garlic / cilantro & paint naan
Serve

title: Moroccan Meatball w/ Shallot Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: Sauce: 1 cup full fat plain Greek yogurt
instructions: Sauce: combine yogurt, mint, lemon. Simmer EVOO, chili flakes, garlic, shallot & add to yogurt. Refrigerate
Combine meatball ingredients, sear on all sides with oil
Serve w/ crispy potatoes

title: Halal Cart Chicken & Rice
ingredients: Cucumber / red onion / lettuce / tomato, diced
EVOO / oregano / cumin / paprika / chili / S&P / Greek
instructions: Dice chicken & marinade w/ EVOO / garlic / lemon / seasonings
Add butter to hot pan. Add turmeric, toast. Add cleaned rice. Add water. Cook 12 min
Cook chicken on high
Assemble plate w/ rice, chicken, cucumber / lettuce / tomato / onion salad & yogurt sauce & sriracha

title: Pizza Dough (NY / Neo Hybrid, 16 hour)
ingredients: 4 x 14 in pizzas, makes 4 x 280 g balls
274 g King Arthur bread flour (high protein)
instructions: Add ADY to cold water (60°) in mixer bowl
Whisk in 1 cup flour
Turn on mixer (lowest setting), add rest of flour
Add salt & EVOO
Once combined, rest 5 min covered plastic wrap
Mix for 5 more min, rest covered 5 min
Mix for 5 more min, rest covered 5 min
Bulk ball up on counter, put back in bowl covered on counter 2 hr (better overnight)
Ball up to 280 g / 360 g & place in fridge covered for 1-3 days
Remove from fridge, rest covered on counter 1-3 hrs

title: Quiggly's Focaccia Bread
instructions: Whisk yeast, honey, warm water, sit for 5 min. Add flour & salt in 2nd bowl, and pour in yeast water. Lightly mix / combine w/ spatula. Let sit at room temp covered w/ towel for 10 min
In 3rd bowl, add 4 tbs EVOO & dough & mix
Using spatula, pull dough from outside into itself. Cover w/ plastic wrap and put in refrigerator for 12-48 hours (3.5 pull over itself, move to pan)
Move dough to greased (EVOO) 9x13 pan and let rise undisturbed 2-4 hours at room temp
Dimple dough, add toppings / salt / EVOO
Immediately bake in oven at 450° for 20-25 min

title: Quiggly's Pasta Dough
ingredients: 2 - 2.5 cups (285 g) 00 pasta flour or semolina flour
7 egg yolk & 1 full egg (Happy Egg heritage free range)
instructions: Pour flour on countertop. Form hole in middle to hold eggs. Drop in eggs / EVOO & combine
Slowly mix flour into eggs as you whisk. Once chunky, chop together with bench scraper
Knead dough for 5-10 min into ball. Add water as needed. Cover in plastic wrap for 10 min
Knead again for 5 min, cover in plastic wrap for 1 hr
After 1 hr, section into quarters and make pasta. Cook ~3 min

title: Agi's Famous Garlic Bread
instructions: Put garlic in foil w/ olive oil, salt, pepper, and roast on 400° for 45 min
Melt butter and combine w/ all ingredients
Add butter / garlic mixture to bread and broil under done / crispy

title: Quesabirria Tacos
ingredients: Ancho / guajillo peppers, dried (chile de arbol too)
Salt, pepper, cumin, paprika, bay leafs, oregano, chipotle Dan-O's
instructions: Cut open chili's, remove seeds. Heat in pot w/ oil
Dice onion, tomatoes & add to pot w/ garlic, salt / pepper, and seasonings & tomato paste & chipotles
Cook for a bit, add beef broth, and simmer 5 min. Add water if needed
Blend sauce
Season chopped chuck roast & sear all sides and add to pot w/ sauce & cook down a while
Shred beef and build tacos
Put cheese down in non-stick & heat. Add tortilla and build taco then flip

title: Birria-Style Chicken Bowl
instructions: Cut chiles and remove seed / ends. Place in pot with 1/2 onion, tomato, chicken broth. Boil / simmer 5-10 min
Add to blender w/ 1 cup liquid from pot and garlic, seasoning, chipotles
Season / sear chicken in pot. Add sauce over chicken and cook till done. Shred chicken and serve

title: Slow Cooker Carnitas Fried Cheese Tacos
ingredients: Rub: chicken seasoning (heavy), taco seasoning, salt, pepper, garlic, oregano / cumin / chili
A little: chicken broth, ghost pepper sauce, BBQ, salsa
instructions: Trim & season meat with seasoning rub
Place meat in slow cooker w/ all other ingredients and cook on slow for 9.5-10 hr (flip meat 1/2 through)
Pull from cooker, shred, return to pot
Add additional seasoning to taste
To crisp: heat small portion over on in pan
Add cheese to 1 side of different pan on medium
Add tortilla to pan & meat / cheese filling
Flip cheese side over top
Serve

title: Agi's Breakfast Burrito
ingredients: Burrito: couple pinches Mexican shredded cheese
Avocado sauce: 1 scoop chili onion crunch
instructions: Combine all ingredients of avocado sauce & set aside
Cook hashbrown & set aside
Cook onion / garlic over med. heat w/ oil
Add sausage & chop / combine
Once sausage is cooked, add egg & scramble
Add cheese
Combine all ingredients into burrito and sear on ridged pan till marks appear (~2 min a side)

title: Tooney's Cakes
instructions: Blend & make cakes

title: Eggs Benny, Quiggly-Style
instructions: Toast muffin
Fry Canadian bacon
Fry / poach egg
Make hollandaise: egg yolks in glass w/ lemon, Dijon, seasonings & slowly blend in melted butter w/ hand blender
Assemble & serve

title: Gnocchi Sausage Soup
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium. Cook diced onion until translucent
Add minced garlic and stir 30 seconds
Add sausage and break apart as it browns
Once cooked through, add tomato paste and seasonings. Stir until evenly coated
Pour in chicken broth and bring to a boil
Add dry gnocchi straight into the boiling soup. Cook 2-3 min
Reduce heat to low, stir in heavy cream
Add parmesan and stir until melted and smooth
Fold in chopped spinach
Simmer on low 10 min to thicken. Serve
notes: From The Everyday Cookbook. The original calls for beef or chicken bone broth, so it's chicken here, and the garlic is doubled to 8 cloves. Not yet on a card.

title: Feta & Cherry Tomato Pasta Bake
ingredients: 8 oz block feta (in brine, not pre-crumbled)
2-3 Calabrian chilis, chopped (or 1 tbs red pepper flakes)
2-3 sprigs fresh herbs (basil, oregano or thyme)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°
Pour half the EVOO into a baking dish. Add tomatoes, halved garlic cloves, shallot and chilis. Season w/ salt & pepper and toss
Set the feta block in the middle, flip a couple times to coat. Tuck herb sprigs between the tomatoes, drizzle remaining EVOO, sprinkle oregano
Bake 30-35 min until the tomatoes burst and the feta softens
Move to the top rack and broil 5 min for char. Watch it
Meanwhile cook pasta al dente in salted water. Reserve 1 cup pasta water
Pull the dish, add fresh basil, and mash / stir until the feta melts into a creamy sauce
Toss in the pasta, loosening with pasta water until it coats
Top w/ parm and more basil
notes: Built from a few online versions. The whole roasted garlic head, the block feta in brine, and the 5 min broil at the end are what make it better than the standard viral one. Not yet on a card.
